# PreFlight

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before working in this repository.
Read [the plan](../docs/plan.md) and [the handoff](../docs/handoff-2026-11-01.md)
for scope and current verification status. Repository instructions remain authoritative
over generated workflow templates.

Use Context7 for public library documentation when available. Queries must contain
only public library names and generic API questions, never secrets, customer data,
private source code or held-out evaluation data. Fall back to official documentation.

For independent reviews, return concrete findings with file locations and verification
steps. Do not edit files or run commands unless the coordinating task authorizes them.
